name: Roth.weight_nonneg
source:
theorem weight_nonneg (r : σ → ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : 0 ≤ weight r d :=
  Fintype.sum_nonneg fun _ ↦ by positivity

name: Roth.weight_zero
source:
theorem weight_zero (r : σ → ℕ) : weight r 0 = 0 := by
  simp [weight]

name: Roth.weight_add
source:
theorem weight_add (r : σ → ℕ) (d e : σ →₀ ℕ) : weight r (d + e) = weight r d + weight r e := by
  simp [weight, add_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib]

name: Roth.weight_eq_zero_iff
source:
theorem weight_eq_zero_iff {r : σ → ℕ} (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) {d : σ →₀ ℕ} :
    weight r d = 0 ↔ d = 0 := by
  simp [weight, Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg, div_nonneg, (hr _).ne', Finsupp.ext_iff]

name: Roth.weight_single
source:
theorem weight_single (r : σ → ℕ) (j : σ) (n : ℕ) : weight r (Finsupp.single j n) = n / r j := by
  classical
  simp [weight, Finsupp.single_apply, ite_div]

name: Roth.weight_le_card
source:
theorem weight_le_card {r : σ → ℕ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ} (hd : ∀ j, d j ≤ r j) :
    weight r d ≤ Fintype.card σ :=
  (Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ div_le_one_of_le₀ (by exact_mod_cast hd j) (by positivity)).trans_eq
    (by simp)

name: Roth.weight_mul_left
source:
theorem weight_mul_left {l : ℕ} (r : σ → ℕ) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    weight (fun j ↦ l * r j) d = weight r d / l := by
  simp [weight, Finset.sum_div, div_div, mul_comm]

name: Roth.weight_le_degree_div
source:
theorem weight_le_degree_div {r : σ → ℕ} {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (hr : ∀ j, m ≤ r j) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    weight r d ≤ d.degree / m := by
  rw [weight, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div]
  gcongr with j
  exact hr j

name: Roth.weight_mapDomain
source:
theorem weight_mapDomain {τ : Type*} [Fintype τ] {f : σ → τ} (hf : Function.Injective f) (r : τ → ℕ)
    (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : weight r (d.mapDomain f) = weight (r ∘ f) d := by
  simpa [Finsupp.sum_fintype, weight] using
    Finsupp.sum_mapDomain_index_inj (s := d) (h := fun j n ↦ (n : ℝ) / r j) hf

name: Roth.index
source:
noncomputable def index (P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) : ℝ :=
  sInf (weight r '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)))

name: Roth.index_le_weight
source:
theorem index_le_weight {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ} {d : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (h : eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0) : index P α r ≤ weight r d :=
  csInf_le ((taylor α P).support.finite_toSet.image (weight r)).bddBelow
    (Set.mem_image_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_coe.2 (mem_support_taylor_iff.2 h)))

name: Roth.exists_weight_eq_index
source:
theorem exists_weight_eq_index {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    ∃ d, eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0 ∧ weight r d = index P α r := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd, hdw⟩ :=
    (show (weight r '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))).Nonempty by
      simpa using hP).csInf_mem ((taylor α P).support.finite_toSet.image (weight r))
  exact ⟨d, mem_support_taylor_iff.1 hd, hdw⟩

name: Roth.le_index_iff
source:
theorem le_index_iff {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) {α : σ → ℝ} {r : σ → ℕ} {c : ℝ} :
    c ≤ index P α r ↔ ∀ d, eval α (hasseDeriv d P) ≠ 0 → c ≤ weight r d := by
  refine ⟨fun h d hd ↦ h.trans (index_le_weight hd), fun h ↦ ?_⟩
  refine le_csInf (by simpa using hP) ?_
  rintro _ ⟨d, hd, rfl⟩
  exact h d (mem_support_taylor_iff.1 hd)

name: Roth.index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv
source:
theorem index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} {k : σ →₀ ℕ}
    (hk : hasseDeriv k P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r - weight r k ≤ index (hasseDeriv k P) α r := by
  obtain ⟨i, hi, hiw⟩ := exists_weight_eq_index hk α r
  rw [hasseDeriv_hasseDeriv, smul_eq_C_mul, map_mul, eval_C, mul_ne_zero_iff] at hi
  exact sub_le_iff_le_add.2 (by simpa [weight_add, hiw] using index_le_weight (r := r) hi.2)

name: Roth.weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div
source:
theorem weight_eq_finsuppWeight_div {r : σ → ℕ} (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) (d : σ →₀ ℕ) :
    weight r d = (Finsupp.weight (fun j ↦ (∏ i, r i) / r j) d : ℝ) / ∏ i, r i := by
  have hD : (0 : ℝ) < ∏ i, (r i : ℝ) := Finset.prod_pos fun i _ ↦ by exact_mod_cast hr i
  rw [weight, Finsupp.weight_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, Finset.sum_div, Nat.cast_prod]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ ?_
  rw [smul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_mul,
    Nat.cast_div_charZero (Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem _ (Finset.mem_univ j)), Nat.cast_prod,
    ← mul_div_assoc, div_right_comm, mul_div_cancel_right₀ _ hD.ne']

name: Roth.index_mul_left_weights
source:
theorem index_mul_left_weights {l : ℕ} (P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α (fun j ↦ l * r j) = index P α r / l := by
  have himg : weight (fun j ↦ l * r j) '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ)) =
      (l : ℝ)⁻¹ • (weight r '' ((taylor α P).support : Set (σ →₀ ℕ))) := by
    rw [← Set.image_smul, Set.image_image]
    refine Set.image_congr fun d _ ↦ ?_
    rw [weight_mul_left, smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]
  rw [index, index, himg, Real.sInf_smul_of_nonneg (by positivity), smul_eq_mul, div_eq_inv_mul]

name: Roth.index_unique
source:
theorem index_unique [Unique σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0) (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) :
    index P α r =
      (Polynomial.rootMultiplicity (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) : ℝ) / r default := by
  set q := Polynomial.taylor (α default) (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ P) with hqdef
  have key (d : σ →₀ ℕ) : eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = q.coeff (d default) := by
    rw [Polynomial.taylor_coeff, ← uniqueAlgEquiv_hasseDeriv, ← Finsupp.unique_single d]
    exact (eval₂_uniqueAlgEquiv (f := hasseDeriv d P) (φ := RingHom.id ℝ) (a := α)).symm
  have hq : q ≠ 0 := by
    rwa [hqdef, Ne, Polynomial.taylor_eq_zero, map_eq_zero_iff _ (uniqueAlgEquiv ℝ σ).injective]
  rw [Polynomial.rootMultiplicity_eq_natTrailingDegree, ← Polynomial.taylor_apply]
  apply le_antisymm
  · simpa [weight, hqdef] using index_le_weight (P := P) (α := α) (r := r)
      (d := Finsupp.single default q.natTrailingDegree)
      (by simpa [key] using Polynomial.trailingCoeff_nonzero_iff_nonzero.2 hq)
  · refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d hd ↦ ?_
    simpa [weight, hqdef] using div_le_div_of_nonneg_right
      (by exact_mod_cast Polynomial.natTrailingDegree_le_of_ne_zero (key d ▸ hd))
      (Nat.cast_nonneg (r default))

name: Roth.filter_weight_le_eq_empty
Roth.card_filter_fiber_eq
source:
private lemma card_filter_fiber_eq {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (lam : ℝ) (i : ℕ) :
    (((box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc)).filter fun d ↦ weight r
      (d.mapDomain Fin.castSucc + Finsupp.single (Fin.last n) i) ≤
        (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - lam) / 2).card : ℝ) =
      (((box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc)).filter fun d ↦ weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤
        ((n : ℝ) - (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / r (Fin.last n))) / 2).card : ℝ) := by
  congr 2
  refine Finset.filter_congr fun d _ ↦ ?_
  rw [weight_add, weight_mapDomain (Fin.castSucc_injective n), weight_single, mul_div_assoc]
  grind

name: Roth.card_filter_weight_le_of_le_sqrt_aux
source:
private lemma card_filter_weight_le_of_le_sqrt_aux (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) {lam : ℝ}
    (hlam : 0 < lam) (h : lam ≤ 2 * √(m : ℝ)) : (((box r).filter fun d ↦
      weight r d ≤ ((m : ℝ) - lam) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * √(m : ℝ) / lam * ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by
  classical
  calc _ ≤ ((box r).card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast Finset.card_filter_le (box r) _
    _ = ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by simp [card_box]
    _ ≤ _ := le_mul_of_one_le_left (by positivity) ((one_le_div hlam).2 h)

name: Roth.card_filter_weight_le_succ_aux
source:
private lemma card_filter_weight_le_succ_aux {n : ℕ} (r : Fin (n + 1) → ℕ) (hr : 0 < r (Fin.last n))
    (hn : 0 < n) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 2 * √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) < lam) (ih : ∀ {t : ℝ}, 0 < t →
      (((box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc)).filter fun d ↦ weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤
        ((n : ℝ) - t) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤ 2 * √(n : ℝ) / t * ∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) :
    (((box r).filter fun d ↦ weight r d ≤ (((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) - lam) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / lam * ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by
  set R := r (Fin.last n)
  have hs := sum_inv_lt (r := R) (m := n + 1) hr (Nat.succ_le_succ hn) hlam
  push_cast [add_sub_cancel_right] at hs
  rw [card_filter_box_last, Nat.cast_sum,
    Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ card_filter_fiber_eq r lam i]
  calc ∑ i ∈ range (R + 1), (((box (r ∘ Fin.castSucc)).filter fun d ↦
          weight (r ∘ Fin.castSucc) d ≤ ((n : ℝ) - (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / R)) / 2).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ range (R + 1), 2 * √(n : ℝ) / (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / R) *
          ∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1) := by
        refine Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ ih ?_
        linarith [Real.one_le_sqrt.2 (by simp : (1 : ℝ) ≤ ((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)),
          show 0 ≤ 2 * (i : ℝ) / R by positivity]
    _ = 2 * √(n : ℝ) * (∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) *
          ∑ i ∈ range (R + 1), (lam - 1 + 2 * (i : ℝ) / R)⁻¹ := by
        rw [Finset.mul_sum]
        exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ ↦ by ring
    _ ≤ 2 * √(n : ℝ) * (∏ j, (((r ∘ Fin.castSucc) j : ℝ) + 1)) *
          (lam⁻¹ * (√(n : ℝ))⁻¹ * √((n : ℝ) + 1) * (R + 1)) :=
        mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hs.le (by positivity)
    _ = 2 * √((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) / lam * ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by
        rw [Fin.prod_univ_castSucc]
        push_cast
        field_simp
        simp [R]

name: Roth.card_filter_weight_le
source:
theorem card_filter_weight_le (m : ℕ) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) {lam : ℝ} (hlam : 0 < lam)
    : (((box r).filter fun d ↦ weight r d ≤ ((m : ℝ) - lam) / 2).card : ℝ) ≤
      2 * √(m : ℝ) / lam * ∏ j, ((r j : ℝ) + 1) := by
  classical
  induction m generalizing lam with
  | zero =>
    rw [filter_weight_le_eq_empty r (by simpa using hlam)]
    simp
  | succ n ih =>
    by_cases h : lam ≤ 2 * √(((n + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ))
    · exact card_filter_weight_le_of_le_sqrt_aux (n + 1) r hlam h
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with rfl | hn
    · rw [filter_weight_le_eq_empty r (by
        norm_num at h ⊢
        linarith), card_empty, Nat.cast_zero]
      positivity
    exact card_filter_weight_le_succ_aux r (hr _) hn (lt_of_not_ge h) (ih _ fun j ↦ hr _)

name: Roth.abs_prod_pow_le_rpow_of_le_weight
source:
private lemma abs_prod_pow_le_rpow_of_le_weight {m : ℕ} [NeZero m] {r q : Fin m → ℕ}
    (hq : ∀ j, 0 < q j) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) {x : Fin m → ℝ} (hx : ∀ j, |x j| ≤ 1 / (q j : ℝ) ^ κ)
    (hqr : ∀ j, (q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j) ≤ q j) (d : Fin m →₀ ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hw : c ≤ weight r d)
    : |∏ j, x j ^ d j| ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
  have hqR : ∀ j, (0 : ℝ) < q j := fun j ↦ by exact_mod_cast hq j
  have hq1 : (1 : ℝ) ≤ q 0 := by exact_mod_cast hq 0
  rw [Finset.abs_prod]
  calc ∏ j, |x j ^ d j|
      ≤ ∏ j, (q j : ℝ) ^ (-κ * d j) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ ↦ abs_nonneg _) fun j _ ↦ ?_
        rw [abs_pow, Real.rpow_mul (hqR j).le, Real.rpow_natCast,
          Real.rpow_neg (hqR j).le, ← one_div]
        exact pow_le_pow_left₀ (abs_nonneg _) (hx j) _
    _ ≤ ∏ j, ((q 0 : ℝ) ^ ((r 0 : ℝ) / r j)) ^ (-κ * d j) := by
        refine Finset.prod_le_prod₀ (fun j _ ↦ by positivity) fun j _ ↦ ?_
        exact Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_nonpos (by positivity) (hqr j)
          (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (neg_nonpos.2 hκ) (Nat.cast_nonneg _))
    _ = (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * κ * weight r d) := by
        simp_rw [← Real.rpow_mul (hqR 0).le]
        rw [← Real.rpow_sum_of_pos (hqR 0), weight, Finset.mul_sum]
        exact congrArg _ (Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ ↦ by ring)
    _ ≤ (q 0 : ℝ) ^ (-(r 0 : ℝ) * c * κ) := by
        apply Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le hq1
        convert mul_le_mul_of_nonpos_left hw
          (neg_nonpos.2 (mul_nonneg (Nat.cast_nonneg (r 0)) hκ)) using 1 <;> ring

name: Roth.le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero
source:
theorem le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    {r : σ → ℕ} (hd : ∀ j, degreeOf j P ≤ r j) (α : σ → ℝ) {c : ℝ}
    (hvan : ∀ d, (∀ j, d j ≤ r j) → weight r d < c → eval α (hasseDeriv d P) = 0) :
    c ≤ index P α r := by
  refine (le_index_iff hP).2 fun d he ↦ le_of_not_gt fun hw ↦ he (hvan d (fun j ↦ ?_) hw)
  by_contra! hj
  exact he <| by rw [hasseDeriv_eq_zero_of_degreeOf_lt ((hd j).trans_lt hj), map_zero]

name: Roth.exists_hasseDeriv_eval_ne_zero
source:
theorem exists_hasseDeriv_eval_ne_zero {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {P : MvPolynomial σ ℝ} (hP : P ≠ 0)
    (α : σ → ℝ) (r : σ → ℕ) {c : ℝ} (hc : index P α r < c) : ∃ k : σ →₀ ℕ,
    weight r k < c ∧ eval α (hasseDeriv k P) ≠ 0 :=
  (exists_weight_eq_index hP α r).imp fun _ ⟨hd, hw⟩ ↦ ⟨hw ▸ hc, hd⟩

name: Roth.exists_mem_RSet_le_index_aux
source:
private lemma exists_mem_RSet_le_index_aux {σ : Type*} [Fintype σ] {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α : ℝ}
    (hf : f.Monic) (hfα : Polynomial.aeval α f = 0) (r : σ → ℕ) (B C : ℕ) (J : Finset (σ →₀ ℕ))
    {γ : ℝ} (hC : ∀ W ∈ boxFamily r B, ∀ j ∈ J, ∀ i < f.natDegree,
      |(diag (hasseDeriv j W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ (C : ℤ))
    (hcount : ((2 * C + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) ^ (f.natDegree * J.card) < ((B : ℝ) + 1) ^ (∏ k, (r k + 1) : ℕ))
    (hJ : ∀ d, (∀ k, d k ≤ r k) → weight r d < γ → d ∈ J) : ∃ P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ, P ∈ RSet B r ∧
      γ ≤ index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) P) (fun _ ↦ α) r := by
  obtain ⟨W', hW', W'', hW'', hne, hWeq⟩ := exists_ne_modByMonic_eq r B hf J C hC
    (by simpa [finprod_eq_prod_of_fintype] using hcount)
  -- `W* = W' - W''`
  have hP := sub_mem_RSet hW' hW'' hne
  refine ⟨W' - W'', hP, ?_⟩
  exact le_index_of_forall_eval_eq_zero
    ((map_ne_zero_iff _ (MvPolynomial.map_injective _ Int.cast_injective)).2 hP.1)
    (by simpa only [degreeOf,
          degrees_map_of_injective _ (f := Int.castRingHom ℝ) Int.cast_injective]
        using hP.2.1) (fun _ ↦ α)
    fun d hd hw ↦ eval_hasseDeriv_sub_eq_zero hfα (hWeq d (hJ d hd hw))

name: Roth.mul_card_filter_weight_le_aux
source:
private lemma mul_card_filter_weight_le_aux {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m) (r : Fin m → ℕ) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j)
    (a : ℝ) : a * (((box r).filter fun d ↦ weight r d ≤ ((m : ℝ) - 4 * a * √(m : ℝ)) / 2).card : ℝ)
      ≤ ((∏ j, (r j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by
  by_cases ha : 0 < a
  · refine (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left
      (card_filter_weight_le m r hr (by positivity)) ha.le).trans_eq ?_
    push_cast
    field_simp [ha.ne', (Real.sqrt_pos.2 (Nat.cast_pos.2 hm)).ne']
    ring
  · exact (mul_nonpos_of_nonpos_of_nonneg (le_of_not_gt ha) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)).trans
      (by positivity)

name: Roth.exists_mem_RSet_le_index_of_rpow_bound_aux
source:
private lemma exists_mem_RSet_le_index_of_rpow_bound_aux {f : Polynomial ℤ} {α A : ℝ} (hf : f.Monic)
    (hfα : Polynomial.aeval α f = 0) (hA : ∀ i, |(f.coeff i : ℝ)| ≤ A) {m : ℕ} (hm : 0 < m)
    (r : Fin m → ℕ) (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) {c β : ℝ} {B s : ℕ} (hB : 0 < B) (hs : ∑ j, r j ≤ s)
    (hAβ : (1 + A) ^ s ≤ β) (hpow : (B : ℝ) * β ^ 3 ≤ (B : ℝ) ^ c) : ∃ P : MvPolynomial (Fin m) ℤ,
      P ∈ RSet B r ∧ ((m : ℝ) - 4 * c * f.natDegree * √(m : ℝ)) / 2 ≤
        index (map (Int.castRingHom ℝ) P) (fun _ ↦ α) r := by
  have hA1 : 1 ≤ A := by simpa [hf.coeff_natDegree] using hA f.natDegree
  have h2 : (2 : ℝ) ^ s ≤ β :=
    (pow_le_pow_left₀ (by norm_num) (by linarith : (2 : ℝ) ≤ 1 + A) s).trans hAβ
  have hc : 1 ≤ c := by
    by_contra! hc
    have hBc : (B : ℝ) ^ c ≤ B := by
      simpa using Real.rpow_le_rpow_of_exponent_le (by exact_mod_cast hB) hc.le
    have hs0 : 0 < s := (hr ⟨0, hm⟩).trans_le
      ((Finset.single_le_sum (fun j _ ↦ Nat.zero_le (r j)) (Finset.mem_univ _)).trans hs)
    have hβ : 1 < β := (one_lt_pow₀ (by norm_num : (1 : ℝ) < 2) hs0.ne').trans_le h2
    exact (not_lt_of_ge hBc) ((lt_mul_of_one_lt_right (Nat.cast_pos.2 hB)
      (one_lt_pow₀ hβ (by decide : 3 ≠ 0))).trans_le hpow)
  -- the bound `C` for the remainders
  let Cn := ⌊(B : ℝ) ^ c⌋₊
  have hC : ∀ W ∈ boxFamily r B, ∀ j i,
      |(diag (hasseDeriv j W) %ₘ f).coeff i| ≤ (Cn : ℤ) := by
    intro W hW j i
    have hcW : ∀ e, |(W.coeff e : ℝ)| ≤ B := fun e ↦ by
      exact_mod_cast (abs_of_nonneg (hW.2 e).1).trans_le (hW.2 e).2
    exact (abs_coeff_diag_hasseDeriv_modByMonic_le_floor_aux
      hA hW.1 hcW hs h2 hAβ j i).trans (by exact_mod_cast Nat.floor_mono hpow)
  let J := (box r).filter fun d ↦
    weight r d ≤ ((m : ℝ) - 4 * c * f.natDegree * √(m : ℝ)) / 2
  -- the counting inequality
  have hD : c * f.natDegree * J.card ≤ ((∏ j, (r j + 1) : ℕ) : ℝ) / 2 := by
    simpa [J, mul_assoc] using mul_card_filter_weight_le_aux hm r hr (c * f.natDegree)
  exact exists_mem_RSet_le_index_aux hf hfα r B Cn J
    (fun W hW j _ i _ ↦ hC W hW j i)
    (pigeonhole_count (Nat.cast_pos.2 hB) hc (Finset.prod_pos fun j _ ↦ Nat.succ_pos _) hD)
    (fun d hd hw ↦ Finset.mem_filter.2 ⟨mem_box.2 hd, hw.le⟩)

name: Roth.sum_max_sub_le_index_det
source:
theorem sum_max_sub_le_index_det {R : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℝ} {l : ℕ} (D : Fin l → (τ →₀ ℕ))
    (hD : ∀ μ, (D μ).degree ≤ μ) (hdet : (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦
      hasseDeriv ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R).det ≠ 0) (α : Option τ → ℝ)
    {r : Option τ → ℕ} (hr : ∀ j, 0 < r j) {δ : ℝ}
    (hδ : ∀ d : τ →₀ ℕ, d.degree ≤ l - 1 → weight (r ∘ some) d ≤ δ) :
    ∑ ν ∈ Finset.range l, max 0 (index R α r - ν / r none) - l * δ ≤
      index (Matrix.of fun μ ν : Fin l ↦
        hasseDeriv ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R).det α r := by
  classical
  set E : Fin l → Fin l → MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℝ := fun μ ν ↦
    hasseDeriv ((D μ).mapDomain some + Finsupp.single none (ν : ℕ)) R
  have hterm : ∀ μ ν : Fin l, E μ ν ≠ 0 →
      max 0 (index R α r - ν / r none) - δ ≤ index (E μ ν) α r := by
    intro μ ν hE
    have h1 := index_sub_weight_le_index_hasseDeriv hE α r
    rw [weight_add, weight_mapDomain (Option.some_injective _), weight_single] at h1
    have h2 := hδ (D μ) ((hD μ).trans (Nat.le_sub_one_of_lt μ.isLt))
    rw [← sub_sub, sub_right_comm] at h1
    rw [sub_le_iff_le_add]
    exact max_le (add_nonneg (index_nonneg _ _ _) ((weight_nonneg _ _).trans h2))
      ((sub_le_iff_le_add).1 ((sub_le_sub_left h2 _).trans h1))
  rw [Matrix.det_apply'] at hdet ⊢
  refine le_index_sum hdet fun s _ hs ↦ ?_
  have hprod : ∏ i, Matrix.of E (s i) i ≠ 0 := (mul_ne_zero_iff.mp hs).2
  have hentry (i : Fin l) : Matrix.of E (s i) i ≠ 0 :=
    (Finset.prod_ne_zero_iff.1 hprod) i (Finset.mem_univ _)
  have hidx : index (((Equiv.Perm.sign s : ℤ) : MvPolynomial (Option τ) ℝ) *
      ∏ i, Matrix.of E (s i) i) α r = index (∏ i, Matrix.of E (s i) i) α r := by
    simpa only [map_intCast] using
      index_C_mul (Int.cast_ne_zero.2 (Units.ne_zero (Equiv.Perm.sign s)))
        (∏ i, Matrix.of E (s i) i) α r
  rw [hidx, index_prod _ (fun i _ ↦ hentry i) α hr,
    ← Fin.sum_univ_eq_sum_range (fun ν : ℕ ↦ max 0 (index R α r - ν / r none)) l]
  have hlδ : (l : ℝ) * δ = ∑ _i : Fin l, δ := by rw [Fin.sum_const, nsmul_eq_mul]
  rw [hlδ, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i _ ↦ hterm (s i) i (hentry i)

name: Roth.weight_le_delta_aux
source:
private lemma weight_le_delta_aux {δ : ℝ} (hδ : 0 ≤ δ) {r : Option τ → ℕ}
    (hratio : ∀ j, (r none : ℝ) ≤ δ * r (some j)) {d : τ →₀ ℕ} (hd : d.degree ≤ r none) :
    weight (r ∘ some) d ≤ δ := by
  classical
  by_cases hr : r none = 0
  · rw [(Finsupp.degree_eq_zero_iff d).1 (Nat.eq_zero_of_le_zero (hr ▸ hd))]
    simpa [weight] using hδ
  have hrp : (0 : ℝ) < r none := by exact_mod_cast Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hr
  calc weight (r ∘ some) d = ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) / r (some j) := rfl
    _ ≤ ∑ j, (d j : ℝ) * δ / r none := Finset.sum_le_sum fun j _ ↦ by
        rw [div_le_div_iff₀ (pos_of_mul_pos_right (hrp.trans_le (hratio j)) hδ) hrp, mul_assoc]
        exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hratio j) (Nat.cast_nonneg _)
    _ = δ * d.degree / r none := by
        rw [← Finset.sum_div, ← Finset.sum_mul, Finsupp.degree_eq_sum, Nat.cast_sum, mul_comm]
    _ ≤ δ := (div_le_iff₀ hrp).2 (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (by exact_mod_cast hd) hδ)
